title: We booked this tour to...
text: We booked this tour to experience Barcelona before our cruise. Our guide Gloria was really amazing! She was raised in Barcelona so really knew the best places. We felt like our day was personalized to what we wanted to see at a pace that was comfortable but maximized our short time there. Barcelona was amazing and this tour hit all the highlights.
author: Debra_C

title: All over Barcelona
text: This was a perfect day tour for a comprehensive experience of Barcelona's tourism highlights. From walking through the Gothic Quarter to visiting great views of the city to seeing Gaudí's greatest works, we packed in a lot without feeling rushed. Our guide Miguel was fantastic. He provided a lot of history and took great pictures! Miguel also took time to get to know everyone in our group and made us feel welcome. Whether it's a first time in Barcelona or one of many visits, this tour has something that everyone will enjoy. A great choice for a 'day before a cruise' tour.
author: Walter_G

title: Best day in Barcelona
text: Gaudi is astonishing, Sagrado Familia the highlight of a 3 week trip. Our guide Miguel was personable and highly knowledgeable.  His insight and access made the fee for a small group tour well worthwhile.
author: G7482FTmichaelh

title: Great taste of Barcelona
text: Terriffic tour seeing most of the great sites of Barcelona - ie. Gaudi! We were lucky enough to be in a tiny group of 4 with 1 other lovely couple. Nuria was an excellent and passionate guide. Highly recommend
author: kathw219

title: A daytrip to remember
text: We had a really memorable day with Ana  Sanchez our tour guide who is commendable for being professional. She exquisitely narrated the history of Barcelona and Gaudi’s masterpieces with so much passion.
author: mariamalvar98

title: Ana Sanchez is such a...
text: Ana Sanchez is such a lovely, charismatic, knowledgeable tour guide. I learned a lot of history of Spain from her. I rate this tour 5 stars
author: MariaRomina_M

title: Barcelona City Tour
text: The whole day was amazing. Our guide Miguel took us through a walking tour through the Gothic Quarter and then a coordinated riding tour of Guadi's Sagarda Familia Church, Park Guell, and Casa Mila. In addition there was a lot of information given between the rides between the attractions. Miguel was well informed and gave us a lot of information on all of the areas we visited. I would highly recommend this tour. It showed us so much of the city in a short time.
author: Den_K

title: Amazing tume
text: We ended up the only ones on tour, so basically had a private tiur and Joseph was a great guide and knew his stuff. Great time.

title: Our guide was a blast … knowledgeable and Fun
text: Josef was fantastic!   We had a rainy cold day and he modified our tour to avoid the rain while still creating a wonderful experience.  He was extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of Barcelona, giving us both great history and a sense of the culture in the past and currently.  Don’t miss it if you visit Barcelona!
author: kerrim52

title: Fantastic Barcelona Tour
text: This touring experience was exceptional. Our guide, Miguel Suarez Perez was friendly, charming and extremely knowledgeable. Spending 7 hours with him, touring the city was like spending the day with a good friend. We learned so much about the city, it's people, it's history and architecture. We are looking forward to exploring Miguel's recommendations for this evening and tomorrow. We highly recommend Miguel's services and the weareguidesbarcelona tour company.
